resources.string: Reads what\'s on screen and taps/swipes/types on your behalf to carry out tasks you ask for in chat. Only acts when you have started a request yourself.

New to Secretary Kim? Tap an item below to see the details.

1. Tap the "Turn on in Settings" button below.
2. Tap "Downloaded apps", then find and tap "Secretary Kim".
3. Tap the "Off" switch, then tap "Allow" on the popup that appears.
4. Press Back a few times to return to Secretary Kim.
1. Tap the \"Turn on\" button below.\n2. Tap \"Allow\" on the system popup.
③ Turn on voice input (microphone) permission
1. Tap the \"Turn on\" button below.\n2. Tap \"While using the app\" on the popup that appears.\n3. Later, tap the microphone icon next to the message box in chat to send messages by voice.
1. Tap the \"Turn on\" button below.\n2. Tap \"While using the app\" on the popup that appears.\n3. Later, you can take a photo to attach directly in chat.
⑤ Turn on file access permission

1. Tap the "Turn on in Settings" button below.
2. On the screen that opens, turn on the switch to allow "All files access".
3. Press Back to return to Secretary Kim.
4. From then on, you don't need to attach anything — just mention a document by name in chat and the AI can find and read it on its own.
① Where to set the fixed prompt
Tap the gear (⚙) icon in the top right of the chat screen anytime to check or change your fixed prompt and your API key.
② While a task is running

• Don\'t turn off the screen — the task may stop if the screen turns off.\n• Please wait without touching anything else until it\'s done.\n• To stop immediately, tap the \"■ Stop\" button on the chat screen.
③ How to come back afterward
When the task finishes, a brief notification appears at the top of the screen. Tap it to jump straight back to the chat.
④ How to set up your API key

Secretary Kim runs on a Claude API key you get yourself.

1. Sign up and log in at console.anthropic.com.
2. Go to "API Keys" in the left menu and create a new key (it starts with sk-ant-).
3. Copy the key, then open the gear (⚙) icon in the chat screen → "API Key Setup", paste it in, and save.

Anthropic bills you directly for what you actually use — Secretary Kim itself doesn't charge anything.
